channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: IAEA confirms signs of activity at Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site
item.description: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi says remote imagery shows movement at Iran’s fortified Pickaxe Mountain site, but inspectors still do not know what is underway.

item.title: ‘I will sit in prison’: Israeli refuses to comply with IDF order
item.description: Court orders Tal Yinon Derdik held until end of proceedings after alleged violations of an administrative order issued by Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba terrorist who killed Nahal commander
item.description: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba terrorist Ismail Kandil, who took part in killing Col. Yonatan Steinberg and recently advanced attacks on Israelis.

item.title: Sylvan Adams & Ron Dermer: 'Israel must use its power to oppose war against Jews'
item.description: At Los Angeles stop of Dermer’s Unite. Lead. Fight. tour, Adams and Dermer call for Israel to deploy its intelligence, cyber and strategic capabilities against antisemitism worldwide.

item.title: More Jews need to train in Michael Rapaport’s style of Jew Fu
item.description: Antisemitism is not a misunderstanding to be corrected. It is a functioning social technology that organizes identity, supplies a scapegoat and simplifies the moral universe for people who want it simplified. Rappaport knows how to deal with it. Opinion.

item.title: Britain’s Jewish foreign secretary knows the Jewish story
item.description: Ed Miliband invoked his family’s refuge in Israel before announcing a policy that economically isolates Jewish communities in the land where Jewish history began.

item.title: Friedman meets settler filmed by Huckabee: ‘This one won’t work’
item.description: David Friedman meets Amishav Melet, the security patrol driver filmed by Mike Huckabee, and pushes back against claims of ‘settler violence.’

item.title: The Chief Rabbi’s Rosh Hashanah Message 5787
item.description: Stand tall as Jews. Be proud of who you are, even when it is difficult.

item.title: Otzma Yehudit: “Netanyahu has already chosen Eisenkot"
item.description: Ben Gvir’s party claims Likud is working to weaken Otzma Yehudit in order to pave the way for a unity government with Gadi Eisenkot.

item.title: Algeria cuts ties with UAE
item.description:
Algeria announced that it was severing relations with the United Arab Emirates, saying it had “exhausted all means of preserving bilateral relations between the two countries."
The announcement provided no further details about the move.

item.title: Houthis seize strategic Red Sea city, threaten key shipping route
item.description: Capture of Al-Mokha puts Houthi forces closer to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, raising fears of a new chokehold on global trade and energy routes.

item.title: ‘It’s a real threat’: Anti-Israel groups hunt IDF soldiers abroad
item.description: Shurat HaDin’s Nitsana Darshan-Leitner warns of an escalating campaign to pursue IDF soldiers abroad and explains how a new app aims to protect them.

item.title: Katz to Iran: Attack Israel, face a blow unlike any before
item.description: Defense Minister sends New Year wishes to Iran's Jews, warns Tehran any attack on Israel will trigger devastating response.

item.title: October 7 intelligence officer fights to keep his identity secret
item.description: Gaza Division officer battles dismissal while asking the Supreme Court to block publication of his name and his account of the October 7 failures.

item.title: With great confidence
item.description: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria....

item.title: Global song unites 17 countries in powerful October 7 tribute to Israel
item.description: A new music video brings voices from 17 countries together to honor October 7 victims and stand with Israel.

item.title: Britain must be held acountable for Hebron - And for Rewarding October 7
item.description: Britain should be tried at the international level and before an international court for its past and present misdeeds. Opinion.

item.title: Missing Ariel man found alive near Qalqilya
item.description: Yaniv Sardal, 53, located alive after massive overnight search involving IDF, Shin Bet, police and elite forces.

item.title: Three M-16 rifles stolen from elite IDF base
item.description: Three M-16 rifles were stolen from soldiers at the Shayetet 13 base in Atlit, with investigators now examining suspicions that an insider was involved.

item.title: Underground tunnel located near Givat Ze'ev
item.description: Border Police discover advanced tunnel hidden inside ancient water cistern near Givat Ze'ev, arrest suspect carrying digging tools.

item.title: Poll: Two-thirds of Jewish voters back Democrats
item.description: New poll shows two-thirds of US Jewish voters likely to favor Democrats in November midterms.

item.title: What employees really want for the holidays
item.description: A new AllJobs survey reveals a striking gap between the holiday gifts employees want and what employers actually give them.

item.title: Caught on camera: Suspect in Prinok baby food poisoning case
item.description: Police release supermarket footage of suspect Yan Shamala, as investigation into anesthetic-laced baby food reaches major breakthrough.

item.title: IDF hits Hamas arsenal in Gaza, destroys three weapons depots
item.description: IDF, Shin Bet, strikes target facilities packed with explosives, anti-tank missiles and other weapons as Hamas attempts to rebuild military capabilities.

item.title: Bereaved father’s Kaddish echoes at Western Wall
item.description: Families who lost loved ones gather for Selichot as father of fallen October 7 soldier dedicates Kaddish to all who gave their lives for Israel.

item.title: Joyful trepidation
item.description: Rosh Hashanah does not simply mark the passage of time. It assigns that time meaning.

item.title: Terrorist involved in murder of MK's husband is eliminated
item.description: Terrorist eliminated in Gaza City strike named as Farah Hamed, senior figure in Hamas' military wing and leader of terror cell; Hamad was among those responsible for murder of Shuli Har-Melekh, husband of MK Limor Son Har-Melekh.

item.title: Trump promises Americans $5,000 if GOP wins midterms
item.description: President Trump has announced a proposed 'Trump Dividend' that could put $5,000 in the hands of every adult American if Republicans retain control of Congress.

item.title: American fighter jets damaged in Iranian attack
item.description: In a recent Iranian attack on a U.S. base in Jordan, about eight F-15 fighter jets sustained minor damage and have already been returned to service.

item.title: Is Britain going to boycott Israeli intelligence warnings too?
item.description: In recent years, Israel's Mossad has helped thwart some 50 attacks in twenty countries, not a few of them in Britain. Perhaps Israel should stop warning ingrates who sanction her to get Muslim votes. Opnion.
